scope.population: retained HPADJ-01 charged current-V22 terminal lower-bound population

exact_proof.prefix_oracle_semantics: the 11 fixed selected pairings extend to a full selected64 pairing vector in the integral Picard image iff the exact HNF prefix-membership congruences hold
exact_proof.oracle_kernel_identification: the depth-11 HNF oracle kernel equals the index-2 parity sublattice ker(x1+x8+x9+x10 mod 2)
exact_proof.kernel_proof_method: verify the parity-kernel Z-basis is accepted by the exact oracle and one odd-parity coset representative is rejected; since the parity kernel has index 2, equality follows
exact_proof.terminal_family_implication: terminal_predicate enforces the same parity condition, so every exact compressed terminal has at least one integer z53 completion
exact_proof.completion_conclusion: for every charged HPADJ terminal there exists at least one selected64 completion whose inverse numerator is divisible by 8 coordinatewise, hence at least one integral retained Picard64 class with the same fixed terminal pairings
